info.title: media-api
info.description: media-api serves the HTTP routes for a Player. Its screen routes redirect to display-api, its audio routes redirect to audio-api, and its media routes compose the two into one muxed stream.

bearer.description: A Kubernetes ServiceAccount token minted with the audience media-api, which this API checks with a TokenReview.

mutualTLS.description: A client certificate the cluster's own authority signed. The subject's common name is the user and its organization values are the groups, which is how the API server reads one.
